about_short_description.short_description: Akudo is a learning-first neobank enabling practical financial education for teenagers.

product.name: Prepaid Card & App
product.description: A financial tool for teenagers aged 11-18 that includes a prepaid Visa card and a mobile app for managing finances.

product.name: UPI & Visa Card
product.description: A payment solution for teenagers aged 11-18 that supports UPI transactions and comes with a personalized Visa card.

product.name: Kudos Rewards
product.description: A rewards program where users earn Kudos points for every spend, which can be redeemed for cashback.

product.name: Shake & Save
product.description: A feature that allows users to add an amount to their savings by shaking their phone.

product.name: Custom Savings Rules
product.description: A feature that lets users create custom rules to automate their savings.

product.name: Financial Literacy Content
product.description: Curated educational content aimed at teaching teenagers practical financial skills.
